verses.pali: “Pañcime, bhikkhave, dhammā samayavimuttassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṁvattanti.
verses.english: “Mendicants, these five things lead to the decline of a mendicant who is temporarily free.

verses.pali: Kammārāmatā, bhassārāmatā, niddārāmatā, indriyesu aguttadvāratā, bhojane amattaññutā.
verses.english: They relish work, talk, and sleep. They don’t guard the sense doors and they eat too much.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca dhammā samayavimuttassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṁvattanti.
verses.english: These five things lead to the decline of a mendicant who is temporarily free.

verses.pali: Pañcime, bhikkhave, dhammā samayavimuttassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṁvattanti.
verses.english: These five things don’t lead to the decline of a mendicant who is temporarily free.

verses.pali: Na kammārāmatā, na bhassārāmatā, na niddārāmatā, indriyesu guttadvāratā, bhojane mattaññutā.
verses.english: They don’t relish work, talk, and sleep. They guard the sense doors and they have moderation in eating.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca dhammā samayavimuttassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṁvattantī”ti.
verses.english: These five things don’t lead to the decline of a mendicant who is temporarily free.”
